Priya Shah: Quick question — I'm planning a temporary hub swap to Tallinn for ~6 weeks (May 12–Jun 23). Will that affect my WFH stipend, payroll, or trigger any tax nexus stuff?
Kelsey Tran: Heads up — thanks for flagging. Where is your official home base currently?
Priya Shah: Home base is Dublin. I'll still be on the same contract, just traveling and using the Tallinn satellite hub for work.
Samir Patel: Short answer: maybe. People Ops + Payroll need the dates so we can evaluate payroll withholding and WFH stipend proration. If it's <90 days normally we don't change home base, but tax rules vary.
People Ops: @Priya Shah thanks — can you fill out the temporary location declaration form? That kicks off payroll + legal checks. Paste below: 
https://intranet.redwood.ai/forms/temp-location-declare
Fields: dates, address, purpose, equipment shipping
Priya Shah: Done (submitted at 10:08).
Payroll Bot: Received declaration for Priya Shah — ticket #PAY-8721 created. Payroll will respond within 3 biz days.
Jared Morrison: Quick note on stipend: WFH allowance is pro-rated by calendar days away from your declared home hub. For <=30 days it's full; 31–90 days we pro-rate monthly; >90 triggers a formal homebase change review.
Kelsey Tran: Also check laptop/equipment shipping — if you need a desk monitor sent to Tallinn we need 10 business days to process export paperwork.
Samir Patel: On tax nexus: Estonia has different digital tax residency rules. For <90 days we usually don't register, but we ask Legal to confirm. People Ops will run the checklist with Legal.
People Ops: Legal flagged two items for Payroll: 1) social security implications, 2) potential withholding change. We'll route to the payroll partner in Estonia if needed. Expect an update by end of week.
Priya Shah: Appreciate it — is there anything I need to do now beyond the form?
People Ops: Please: (1) upload your Tallinn lodging address in the form, (2) keep timesheets as normal, (3) CC payroll@redwood.ai on any travel reimbursements. If Legal asks for a signed attestation we will ping you.
Priya Shah: Got it. One more — will the WFH stipend payment date shift or get split across months?
Jared Morrison: It will reflect the month(s) you are physically away. If your trip spans payroll cycles we'll pro-rate across months. Payroll will show breakdown in the ticket.
Priya Shah: Thanks — feeling better about it. I can adjust dates if there are blocking compliance issues.
Payroll Bot: Payroll update for #PAY-8721: initial review complete — no immediate Estonia payroll registration required for 6-week stay. WFH stipend will be pro-rated across May/June. Final confirmation by 2024-05-03. :white_check_mark:
Kelsey Tran: Awesome. Priya — enjoy Tallinn and ping here if anything changes (timezones, extended dates). :party_parrot:
